user.title: What should the lights follow?
user.description: Choose the picture the lights follow.

tv.title: Choose the TV
tv.description: Glowcast uses the picture of an LG webOS TV that is set up in the LG webOS Smart TV integration.

bridge.title: Choose the Hue bridge
bridge.description: Glowcast streams colours to a Hue bridge that is set up in the Philips Hue integration.

link.title: Pair with the Hue bridge
link.description: Streaming needs its own key from the bridge. Press the link button on your bridge, then click Submit. You then have 30 seconds.

area.title: Choose the entertainment area
area.description: The lights in this area follow the picture. Which lights take part, and where they stand, is set up in the Hue app.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with the Hue bridge again
reauth_confirm.description: The Hue bridge no longer accepts Glowcast's key. Press the link button on your bridge, then click Submit. Your settings are kept.

screen.title: Connect to the screen helper
screen.description: Start the Glowcast screen helper on the computer, then enter the computer's IP address or host name. The helper uses port 8488 unless it was started with another one.

screen_code.title: Pair with the screen helper
screen_code.description: Enter the 6-digit pairing code that the screen helper on {computer} shows.

screen_reauth.title: Pair with the screen helper again
screen_reauth.description: The screen helper on {computer} no longer accepts Glowcast's key. Enter the 6-digit pairing code that the helper shows now. Your settings are kept.

output.title: Which lights should follow the picture?
output.description: You can change this later in Glowcast's settings.

menu_options.ha_lights: Home Assistant lights - any brand, slower

ha_lights.title: Choose the Home Assistant lights
ha_lights.description: Glowcast can follow single lights, the lights of a Home Assistant area, or the lights of a light group (for example a Hue room or zone). Each light gets its own place next to the screen.

ha_lights_lights.title: Choose the lights
ha_lights_lights.description: Only colour lights are listed. A light group (for example a Hue room) chosen here gets one colour for all its lights.

ha_lights_area.title: Choose the area
ha_lights_area.description: Every colour light in this area follows the picture, each at its own place. Lights that join the area later follow the middle of the picture until you place them.

ha_lights_group.title: Choose the light group
ha_lights_group.description: Every colour light in this group follows the picture, each at its own place. Lights that join the group later follow the middle of the picture until you place them.

ha_lights_hue_hint.title: An entertainment area is smoother
ha_lights_hue_hint.description: Some of these are Hue lights that can join an entertainment area. An entertainment area follows the picture much more smoothly: up to 25 changes per second instead of about one. To use it, choose Hue entertainment area in Glowcast's settings later. Click Submit to go on with Home Assistant lights.

ha_lights_hue_no_area.title: An entertainment area is smoother
ha_lights_hue_no_area.description: Some of these are Hue lights that can join an entertainment area, but the bridge has none yet. An entertainment area follows the picture much more smoothly: up to 25 changes per second instead of about one. Make one in the Hue app ([how]({link})), then choose Hue entertainment area in Glowcast's settings. Click Submit to go on with Home Assistant lights.

ha_lights_position.title: Where is {light}?
ha_lights_position.description: Light {number} of {total}. The light follows this part of the picture. Choose Fine-tune to set the place yourself.

ha_lights_fine_tune.title: Fine-tune {light}
ha_lights_fine_tune.description: Light {number} of {total}. -100% is the left or bottom edge of the picture, 100% the right or top edge, 0% the middle.

ha_lights_rate.title: Many lights on one network
ha_lights_rate.description: {count} of these lights share one Hue bridge or Thread network. Glowcast sends at most {limit} commands per second to each, so these lights change about every {seconds} seconds instead of every second. For Hue lights, an entertainment area follows the picture much more smoothly. Click Submit to save anyway.

progress.pair: Waiting for the link button on the Hue bridge (up to 30 seconds).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Hue bridge. Check that it is on and connected to the network.
error.button_not_pressed: The link button was not pressed in time. Press it, then click Submit again.
error.no_areas: This Hue bridge has no entertainment areas yet. Create one in the Hue app (Settings, Entertainment areas), then click Submit.
error.screen_cannot_connect: Could not reach the screen helper. Check that it runs on the computer, the address and the port, and that the computer's firewall allows it.
error.screen_wrong_code: The code is not correct; check the code the helper shows.
error.screen_pairing_unavailable: The screen helper shows no pairing code. Start it without --non-interactive, or with --pairing-code, then try again.
error.screen_other_helper: Another screen helper answers at this address. Check the address.
error.screen_unsupported: This screen helper speaks another version of the protocol. Update Glowcast and the helper.
error.ha_lights_no_lights: Home Assistant has no colour lights yet.
error.ha_lights_no_area: No area in Home Assistant has colour lights. Assign lights to an area first.
error.ha_lights_no_group: Home Assistant has no light groups with colour lights.
error.ha_lights_none_chosen: Choose at least one colour light.

abort.no_tv: No LG webOS TV found. Set up your TV with the LG webOS Smart TV integration first.
abort.no_bridge: No Hue bridge that can stream found. Set up a Hue Bridge v2 or Hue Bridge Pro with the Philips Hue integration first.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Hue bridge. Check that it is on and connected to the network.
abort.already_configured: Glowcast is already set up for this TV.
abort.reauth_successful: Glowcast is paired with the Hue bridge again.
abort.already_in_progress: Glowcast is already being set up for this TV. Finish or close that setup first.
abort.all_tvs_configured: Glowcast is already set up for every LG webOS TV in Home Assistant.
abort.reauth_unavailable: Pairing again is not available for this picture source yet. Remove Glowcast's entry and set it up again.
abort.screen_already_configured: Glowcast is already set up for this computer. Its address is updated.
abort.screen_reauth_successful: Glowcast is paired with the screen helper again.
abort.screen_unsupported: This screen helper speaks another version of the protocol. Update Glowcast and the helper.

init.title: Which lights should follow the picture?
init.description: First the lights and their own settings, then brightness, intensity and the update rate. Together: first the entertainment area, then the Home Assistant lights.

menu_options.combined_options: Entertainment area and Home Assistant lights

menu_option_descriptions.combined_options: Pick lights one by one, or a whole area or light group from Home Assistant; each light gets its own place.

settings.title: Glowcast settings
settings.description: These settings are also on Glowcast's device page, under Configuration, where you can change them while syncing and use them in automations.

data_description.brightness: How bright the lights are at most.
data_description.intensity: How vivid the colours are: 0% is almost white, 100% is as on screen, 200% is extra vivid.
data_description.update_rate: How often the picture is read. The lights always fade smoothly in between.

hue_area_kept.title: Entertainment area

webos_missing.title: Glowcast {name}: the TV is not set up
webos_missing.description: Glowcast cannot sync because the TV it uses is no longer set up in Home Assistant, or is not loaded. Set up the TV again with the LG webOS TV integration (Settings > Devices & services), then switch Glowcast on again.

hue_entertainment_missing.title: Glowcast {name}: the Hue bridge is not set up
hue_entertainment_missing.description: Glowcast cannot sync because the Hue bridge it uses is no longer set up in Home Assistant, is not loaded, or cannot stream. Set up the bridge again with the Philips Hue integration (Settings > Devices & services), then switch Glowcast on again.

hue_entertainment_too_many_channels.title: Glowcast {name}: the entertainment area is too big
hue_entertainment_too_many_channels.description: The entertainment area has more than 20 channels, more than Hue can stream to. Choose a smaller area in Glowcast's settings, or create one with fewer lights in the Hue app.

hue_entertainment_area_not_found.title: Glowcast {name}: the entertainment area no longer exists
hue_entertainment_area_not_found.description: The entertainment area Glowcast streams to was removed from the Hue bridge. Choose another one in Glowcast's settings.

hue_entertainment_bridge_app_left.title: Glowcast {name}: remove its app from the Hue bridge
hue_entertainment_bridge_app_left.description: Glowcast is removed from Home Assistant, but its app is still on the Hue bridge. That app's key gives full access to the bridge. To remove it, open the Hue app and go to **Settings → Apps → Network-based**, tap the info button next to **glowcast** and remove it.

ha_lights_not_found.title: Glowcast {name}: no colour lights to follow
ha_lights_not_found.description: Glowcast cannot sync because the lights it follows are gone: the area or light group was removed, or it has no colour lights left. Choose other lights in Glowcast's settings, then switch Glowcast on again.

loose_lights_in_area.title: Glowcast {name}: Home Assistant lights in the entertainment area
loose_lights_in_area.description: {lights} were added to the entertainment area in the Hue app, so they follow the picture through the area. Glowcast leaves them out of the Home Assistant lights, so that they do not get two colours. To make this message go away, choose the Home Assistant lights again without them in Glowcast's settings (Configure, then "Entertainment area and Home Assistant lights"), or remove them from the entertainment area in the Hue app. The message is checked again the next time Glowcast takes over the lights.

ha_lights_streamed_elsewhere.title: Glowcast {name}: Home Assistant lights in an area another app syncs
ha_lights_streamed_elsewhere.description: Some of Glowcast's Home Assistant lights are in an entertainment area that another app syncs right now, for example a Hue Sync Box or the Hue Sync app: {lights} (area: {areas}). While it syncs, the Hue bridge ignores other commands to these lights, so they do not follow Glowcast; the other lights work as usual, and these follow again when the other app stops. To make them follow Glowcast, choose Home Assistant lights outside that area in Glowcast's settings (Configure), or remove them from the area in the Hue app. The message is checked again the next time Glowcast takes over the lights.

lights_in_area.message: {lights} already follow the TV through the entertainment area, so they cannot also be Home Assistant lights.
